entries.name: nested-box-coll10-accept#0
entries.description: Spending-proof extension {1: Box} whose tree is size-flagged and segregated (header 0x18), constants [Coll^10[Byte], SigmaProp(true)]. The Box is read on the transaction's reader, but the type depth counter is per-type-deserialization (resets for each new type read), so the binding constraint is MaxTypeDepth = 8, not the accumulated value depth. Round-trip identity.

entries.name: nested-box-coll11-reject#1
entries.description: The same Box with constant Coll^11[Byte]: type depth 9 > 8, rejected at type parse. An impl without the type depth limit round-trips it: the over-accept.
